motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Smooth in-page navigation with a small reading inset.

motion.name: workflow-panel-arrive
motion.purpose: Briefly eases the newly selected workflow panel into view.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables smooth scroll and the workflow-panel animation

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: High-priority actions use the monochrome fill with a compact label and arrow.
components.html: Self-host Nivra
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--button); color: var(--button-text); font: 550 14px Geist, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button-primary:hover { opacity: 0.87; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: A low-emphasis action that stays visually light beside the primary button.
components.html: View on GitHub
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; color: var(--fg); font: 500 14px Geist, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-link svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Icon Control
components.description: Theme and copy controls use a clear 44px hit area and soft hover fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark theme"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.8 13A9 9 0 0 1 11 3.2 9 9 0 1 0 20.8 13Z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--soft); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Hero Brand
components.description: The Nivra wordmark introduces the page directly above the tagline; navigation stays out of the hero.
components.html: Nivra
components.css: .ds-hero-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 28px; color: var(--fg); font: 650 21px Geist, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero-brand img { width: 30px; height: 30px; } .ds-hero-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Workflow Tabs
components.description: Four accessible tabs switch the matching workflow copy and product capture.
components.css: .ds-workflow-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; max-width: 100%; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-workflow-tabs button { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 520 14px Geist, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workflow-tabs button:hover, .ds-workflow-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--soft); color: var(--fg); } .ds-workflow-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-workflow-tabs { justify-content: space-between; gap: 0; padding-bottom: 12px; } .ds-workflow-tabs button { padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; } } @media (max-width: 360px) { .ds-workflow-tabs button { padding-inline: 10px; } }

components.name: Installation Panel
components.description: A bordered Docker command panel includes copy feedback and a scrollable code block.
components.html:
Docker quick start
docker run -d --name nivra \
  --restart unless-stopped --init \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -v nivra-data:/app/data \
  ghcr.io/harsh-2002/nivra:latest
Open localhost:3000 to set up your workspace.Copied
components.css: .ds-install { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); } .ds-install-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px 8px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-copy-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy-button:hover { background: var(--soft); } .ds-copy-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-copy-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-install pre { margin: 0; padding: 22px; overflow-x: auto; font: 13px/2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--muted) var(--soft); } .ds-install-footer { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 22px 22px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.6 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-install-footer [role=status] { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 550; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-install-heading { padding-left: 16px; } .ds-install pre { padding: 18px 16px; font-size: 11px; } .ds-install-footer { padding: 0 16px 18px; font-size: 11px; } }

narrative.overview:
Nivra’s visual language is quiet, precise, and approachable. Local Geist carries the words, while a near-monochrome palette leaves attention on the product itself. A restrained hierarchy and generous spacing make a small amount of detail feel considered.

Real Nivra screens do the explaining. The website uses authored demonstration content and identifies it as an example; the N mark and product interface remain the recognizable identity.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained grayscale with paired light and dark modes.
Geist hierarchy, generous spacing, and thin framing.
Real product screens with clearly identified demonstration content.

rules.name: The Neutral-First Rule
rules.body: Use contrast, weight, and tonal surfaces for emphasis; keep the core UI monochrome.

rules.name: The Flat-Frame Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with tonal surfaces and thin strokes; do not add shadow elevation.

dos: Do keep the grayscale palette, bundled Geist, and simple N mark as the website’s visual base.
Do use real Nivra captures with authored demonstration content, visibly described as examples.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, semantic labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't copy Linear or Polar assets or branding; they are references for restraint and hierarchy.
Don't use unverified screenshots, personal data, invented metrics, or testimonials.
